partsSource.method: Each link mesh is split into its connected pieces (triangles that share vertices, welded at 1 µm). Pieces under 0.01 cm³ or 2 mm are export leftovers and join the nearest part. Each part is one triangle range (start, count) of its link in jumper.glb; center and sizeMm are its source bounds in the link frame.
partsSource.names: Ours, from each part’s shape and place: upstream names only the 41 links. Servos are identified by their shared geometry, each centred on its joint’s hinge axis.

added.why: Upstream's RM_calf_link mesh has no servo body; the other three calves have one. Its mesh is otherwise the RR_calf_link mesh vertex for vertex (to 1 µm), so that calf's servo is copied in unchanged.
